notes.notes:
Very quick patch for the [b]exciting new Hallowe'en screensaver[/b] "Here's Looking At You, Kid". I don't think anyone noticed it and as such I'm not going to say what was wrong.

Oh, and there's 20% off for Hallowe'en!

notes.title: Here's Looking At You Kid (and a rather big bug fix)
notes.notes:
Here's Looking At You Kid - the new Hallowe'en screensaver is live. Early! 

...because unfortunately there was a very large bug in the install script that meant that the app wouldn't have worked for anyone who installed it after the last update, so I'm pushing a fix for that now along with all the other code. 

For anyone who has installed since about 1 month ago, and finds the screensaver isn't starting in Windows, please [b]uninstall and reinstall[/b] the app, and it should work properly.

Major thanks to DivviSmalls for helping me to track this down! And I hope you enjoy your eyeballs!

notes.title: Hallowe'en screensaver available for testing (and a bug fix for palettes)
notes.notes:
It's October, you're cold, and Hallowe'en is nearly here- and so is the second annual Jean-Paul Software Screen Explosion Hallowe'en Screensaver! "Here's Looking At You, Kid" is currently available for testing in the beta branch- if someone with an AMD GPU could give it a whirl I'd be extremely grateful as I only have an NVidia one. 

To access the beta branch, go to the app in your library, right click on it and select 'Properties'. In there is a "betas" tab- use the password [b]ilovetestingsoftware[/b] to unlock it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41170677/37dd626ccdf478da58b2d60b93f5247bb5b50170.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41170677/d13b89e37bb32b3a3f3d558934dcdf36d4dc3523.png[/img]

The new screensaver will be officially released alongside the upcoming Steam Scream Fest on the 25th of October. 

This update should also fix a rare issue with custom palettes where deleting one that you were using could cause the app to crash on load.

notes.title: Hotfix: cap framerate for Tunnel O' Fun
notes.notes: Tunnel O' Fun now has it's framerate capped at 60FPS. Let me know if that's too much, or too little.

notes.title: Minor update - Steam API is now optional
notes.notes:
I've added an option to disable the Steam API, which means you can now choose whether or not you want Steam to show that you're using the software when it gets started by Windows. Note that this will also disable achievements, workshop items, any other app integrations that you have enabled (e.g. Discord), and the record of your play time.

To toggle the setting on or off, go to 'Display and Quality Settings' in the settings app, and toggle the option at the bottom labelled 'Enable Steam API', as shown here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41170677/92f0a80a17c7866811ff308b24513e47d7f3170b.png[/img]

Any other requests, please let me know!

Cheers,

-Ed / Jean-Paul Software

P.S. please leave a review, if you can, a) to let me know what you love and hate, and b) to kick Steam's recommendation algorithm up the arse a bit.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Out Now!
notes.notes:
After a long and occasionally torturous development period the Jean-Paul Software Screen Explosion is DONE. Here's a run down of everything achieved with version 1.0:

[list]
[*] 11 screensavers, most of which are good, plus a 'random' button! 
[*] No more bug reports! 
[*] Workshop support! 
[*] Over 93 copies sold!
[*] Functioning code! 
[*] PYLONS OF THE WORLD!
[*] Really cool multi-monitor support!
[*] Steam achievements!
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who has supported this so far, I love you all. I'm going to take a break and then move on to the next thing, which is a game, and probably an easier sell. Probably.

Happy screen exploding,

-Ed / Jean-Paul Software

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes: - Removing the video player for the time being because it's not compatible with Windows 11.

notes.title: Minor update to North Pole Logistics
notes.notes: There's now options for the number of conveyors (and thus number of presents) and the number of drones. The default values are fine but increasing them will make things look more frantic, and decreasing them may improve frame rates.

notes.title: Minor patch, 8th November 2021
notes.notes:
Now Hallowe'en is out of the way, I've added an additional mode to 'Deadline'- it can now be used to keep track of an arbitrary date and time- your birthday, the last time you had a cigarette, the amount of time left until Donald Trump returns to the White House, and so on. 

The clock will also count upwards once the date is in the past, rather than getting stuck at zero. Mechanically this makes no sense for a flip clock, but it looks a lot better.

More updates with feature requests soon, plus I'll be working on something for Christmas.

As always, let me know if there are any issues, or if there are any things you really want to see.

- Ed / Jean-Paul Software

notes.notes: Quick patch to help with troubleshooting

notes.title: Preparing for release and what comes after
notes.notes:
So, hopefully, on the 28th of September, this will be ready for release! Big thanks to everyone who has helped test things so far. If you've got the time, I'd really appreciate it if people could continue to give it a good shakedown. If there's anything that jumps out, please let me know, but as far as I'm aware nearly all the bugs are dealt with. I will continue to post patch notes here, however.

After release, what's next? 

Well, the next big addition is going to be a Hallowe'en screensaver, because people love Hallowe'en. The prototype I've got is *quite* disturbing, but I'm hoping to ramp that up to *very* disturbing.

Workshop support will be added to more of the modules, in particular Probably Enough Fish and Pylons of the World. I am looking forward to seeing flocks of memes floating around.

I'll also be dealing with bug reports, which hopefully won't take up too much time. I've not done a great deal of testing on non-NVidia graphics hardware; there is the possibility this will bite me in the arse.

I owe all of you a beer, and hopefully will be able to give it to you in person

Cheers,

-Ed
